:::{#thm-sum-assoc}
#### Sums are associative

When adding three numbers,
it does not matter which pair you add first:

$$(a + b) + c = a + (b + c)$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-sum-assoc}
#### Grouping a sum two ways

$$
\begin{aligned}
(2 + 3) + 4 &= 5 + 4 \\
&= 9,
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
2 + (3 + 4) &= 2 + 7 \\
&= 9.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
